text: TSA estimate it will enroll 3,400 and graduate at least 1,700 crew members during each year of this training program.  For enrollment, each crew member completes an online registration form and all attendees, at the beginning of the course, signs an Injury Waiver Form and the class roster.  At the end of the course, each participant is asked to return to the CMSD registration page to submit comments regarding the training course electronically using the “Feedback” tab.

text: TSA estimate the total annual hours for this information collection to be 595 hours (311.67 + 283.33).
